manualArguments.name: cone/finite-data-not-convergence-proof
manualArguments.evidence: Numerical checks are supporting checks only. The review uses geometric containment and shrinking polygon-circle difference; it does not derive an infinite limit solely from four rows.

manualArguments.name: asymptotic/inequality-transfer
manualArguments.evidence: For fixed positive integer n, choose m=n+1 in the provided inequality. Divide by positive e^x*x, giving 0 <= x^n/e^x <= (n+1)!/x. This proves the squeeze for every fixed n; m=n merely gives a constant bound and is insufficient.
